notes.title: New Free Update!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to release a new update with community-driven ideas!

Update:

 New World ' Desert'
 New Hidden World to Unlock
 New Puzzle system in free-fly to unlock items and worlds


Other Updates:

 New skydive system, you will now fall at 90 degrees and can pull out of the dive with the glide button for a boost.
 Reimagined Dragon Valley - with new rides and new places to find - can you find the 14 Statues?
 Performance improvements across the board - in preparation for the PSVR release we reworked and improved the performance of the game.


Please let us know what you think! and please review the game if you have not already!

notes.title: New Free World Update!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to provide a free update!

New Re-imagined Canyons World.

 This 16KMx16KM world has lots to discover, from hidden caves to waterfalls and new rides!
 Try Egg Hunt and watch out for those crossbows!
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/b696ccf8238e4eb4bc3252876e9ccf28772b2da5.jpg


New Dragon's to Ride

 You can ride new Dragons as well as and the previous Wyverns in this new update.
 Go to 'Smooth Ride' in Dragon Valley and Volcano Island for the new Dragon. These also move up and down less  - so good for first-time flyers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/b07aca31a3b8cf9a67c3376eb947fbf53539106a.png


New Easter Eggs to Discover! 
We are always adding new little things in the game you can find and some of them have Epic consequences! - Look for them.

Optimizations and other additions

 Freefly - Sprint is now a Toggle (No need to hold it down to sprint)
 New wet skin system
 New Updated Red Dragon Skin 
 New Riding saddle (Multiple Colors)
 Fixed Controls UI to more obvious you can change your controls system.
 Optimized Cartoon Mountain
 Optimized New Canyon Map (30% less processing needed)


Thanks again to you the community for the ideas and feedback!

PLEASE REVIEW THE GAME if you have not already! We are so close to being over 90% positive !! 

Check us out on Twitch and Discord!

notes.title: MAJOR RELEASE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/b818a57781752aa6f2e8d9ab91ddad38b3ddac09.png
The most requested feature for DragonRideVR is now out - FreeFly

FreeFly - You can control your own dragon using the motion controllers or a gamepad:

New Features in FreeFly:

  Walk / Run / Jump / Swim / Fly / Glide Modes
  Fireball 
  Smash / Attack
  Control Customization (see in-game menu)
  Dragon Customization (unlocks)
  New Views - Be the dragon / Ride the Dragon / Outside the Dragon
  Giant Crossbows that can attack
 New Destructible Items: Crates / Doors / Targets / Giant Defence CrossBows
(See FreeFly Guide)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/c649532ea1342cc3f20cc4c92156b285324ea99a.png

New FreeFly Game Modes:
FreeFly - No Time limit just explore - Collect Crystals / Fly through rings.
BallonHunt - Fly into or Shoot balloons to get the highest score before time runs out.
EggHunt - 15 progressive Levels - Find The missing Eggs and unlock customizations, avoid being shot down!

 
2 New Worlds:

 Ice Worlds - Frozen Land
 Canyons - 16KM Map

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/c14693d652bfc57c8492db27514ecde95b5e212a.png


Other Updates:

 Improved seat position on rides
 Dynamic Shadow and VR performance settings
 Update to Dragon Valley Map
 FreeFly LeaderBoards
 FreeFly Achievements
 15 more music tracks to choose from in FreeFly


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/59f2178efddbca521f65a258c761cf1b8b5199fd.png
More Updates to come:

 Leaderboards for Ride Games
 New Giant Cave world


Thanks to all the Beta Tester!

Regards
TypeEhStudios

notes.title: New Version 1.6 Available
notes.notes:
Update:


 New Lightning Spell - Powerful spell that instantly destroys targets and balloons and Catapulted Fireballs!
 More Spells Faster - Earn powerups more often (now every 15,000 points)
 Dual CrossBows all the Time
 New Swimming animation so that immersion is better (Saddle doesn't move under you)
 FlashLights more powerful in the crystal cave level 
 Underwater Glitch Fixed for Index Users
 Optimizations and bug fixes
 Support for HTC COSMOS
 New Epic Engine that improves load times and performance.


Save options are now stored under AppData/Local/DragonRideVR/Saved/SaveGames and will not move going forward.  

If you wish to keep your old high scores and preferences (from v 1.5) do a one time copy from your steamspps/common/DragonRiderVR/Saved/SaveGames to the new location and restart the game (We cannot automate this - sorry)

Thanks for the feedback that helps us improve the game, look for further updates soon.
TypeEhStudios
